COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

   A. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.

   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards

----
